531001.name: Leg Laser
531001.description:
Fires a laser from Kraken's hind leg at a single Nikke, dealing damage.
Attack the Cancel Ring to deal damage to the hind leg.
Generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while the Cancel Ring is active. While the barrier is up, only Electric Code Nikkes can deal damage.

531002.name: Squid Missile
531002.description:
Fires many Squid Missiles at a single Nikke, dealing damage.
Missiles can be intercepted.

531003.name: Focus Laser
531003.description: Fires a laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

531009.name: Tidal Wave
531009.description: Kraken stirs up massive waves, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

531010.name: High-Power Focus Laser
531010.description: Fires a high-power laser at a single Nikke, dealing damage.

531011.name: Hydro Cannon
531011.description: Kraken inhales the surrounding seawater and shoots it out, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

531012.name: Big Leg Smash
531012.description: Kraken vigorously waves its front leg, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
